verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs say Security Rules define what data each user can access across Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database and Cloud Storage, and that the rules can use Authentication to grant user-based permissions at whatever level of granularity an app needs. The Test SDK can load Security Rules for testing in the Emulator Suite. A community user confirms that queries are checked against the access policies before they run, and also notes that the mechanism takes time to grasp. Missing for 10: concrete first-party rule-syntax examples for per-user (e.g., document-owner) restrictions beyond high-level overview statements.
